source: Phone video by the repository owner: the stickerless cube turned by hand in low light over a pale crumpled cloth, phone held sideways. 10 frames per second, shrunk to 480 x 270.
note: faces: the 9 colours of each face in the order shown, row by row as seen. shown: when each face first comes into view, in seconds. brief: faces in view for under half a second (the video starts as the first face is being turned away), too short to capture. The 54 stickers form a valid cube. In the last face the reds are pale (saturation 0.32 to 0.47).
